name: @aegis/relay
description: Relay del Modo A (Fastify + PostgreSQL): Auth Ed25519 challenge-response y sesiones.

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm infra:up && pnpm migrate
scripts.dev: pnpm infra:up && pnpm migrate && dotenv -e .env -- tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.test: pnpm infra:up && pnpm migrate && dotenv -e .env -v LOG_LEVEL=silent -- tsx --test src/auth/auth.test.ts src/directory/directory.test.ts src/messaging/messaging.test.ts src/blocks/blocks.test.ts
